name: Tapeshwar Prasad

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Tapeshwar Prasad writes poetry in English and Hindi. His books include “Vanished Reality and Other Poems”, published by Partridge in 2018, and “Needle of the Night” from Penprints. Cordite Poetry Review is among the journals that have published his work. His poems here use sharply physical images to approach experiences that resist straightforward explanation.

In “Love Came Toddling”, painting, writing and labour form layers of an earlier self before love arrives in small steps. “Windblown Silence” places absence in an emptied valley where a remembered voice continues to cling to the air. The Hindi poem “Aapa-Dhaapi” turns the body into a book and the search for meaning into a thirst whose well-rope breaks. Across these pieces, intimate feeling is tested through matter, movement and interruption.
